_doc: Who reads and writes what. Checked by eval-lint.py. Edit this in the same commit whenever a skill gains or loses a store. Store flags: external (lives outside the repo, e.g. mail, calendar), human (only I write it), terminal (a chat reply, nothing on disk). A store nobody writes fails the lint unless flagged; a store nobody reads warns. Layers are yours to define (capture, work, proof, loop).

context.desc: Confirmed facts and voice: priorities, people, roadmap, voice

signal-cache.desc: One derived digest per day of live sources, expires after ~5 weeks

logs.desc: Run logs, friction log, cost baseline

sources.desc: Mail, calendar, chat, meeting notes, docs: read-only
